name: Grave Fury
description: Smear it on the hooves. Your horses charge like something is chasing them. Something is.

name: Unfeeling Flesh
description: Your horses stop noticing pain. They also stop noticing a few other things. Worry about that later.

name: Whinny of the Damned
description: A sound from under the ground that every horse on the field recognizes. Theirs lose heart.

name: Sanctuary Fog
description: Bottle some smokestack fog and uncork it on the battlefield. The enemy can't see where they're charging. Neither can you, but you're used to it.
